content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice gives 66 vacancies across two posts. It does not break them up by department. The notice calls these vacancies provisional: they may increase or decrease depending upon the actual requirement of the Institution.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: To apply for the post of Demonstrator, a candidate must have a valid MSc Degree and PhD in the same subject, i.e., Anatomy, Biochemistry, Pharmacology, Physiology, and Microbiology, as per NMC Norms. Candidates must fulfil all prescribed educational qualifications and other eligibility conditions as on the prescribed date. Applications will be scrutinised for educational qualifications, age, registration, reservation and other applicable eligibility conditions. Candidates can tick Junior Resident, Tutor/Demonstrator or Both in the "Post Applied for" box of the application form. The age limit is as prescribed under the applicable ESIC/NMC rules and guidelines for the respective post. Age relaxation is admissible to eligible candidates of reserved categories as per the prevailing Government of India rules. Check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility for each post.

rows.qualification: MBBS for Tutor; MSc & PhD for Demonstrator.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The notice does not print an amount or list the individual allowances. The opening paragraph of the notice gives an initial period of 01 (one) year. This is extendable by up to 02 (two) additional years, subject to satisfactory performance, availability of the post and other terms. The maximum tenure is 03 (three) years, or until the joining of the Bonded Junior Resident, whichever is earlier. The "Terms of Contract" section gives an initial tenure of 01 (one) year, extendable by up to 01 (one) additional year. The engagement is liable to termination when the Bonded Junior Resident designated as Tutor or as Demonstrator joins. It can also end under ESIC Headquarters guidelines, whichever is earlier. The engagement is purely temporary. An extension does not give any right or claim to regular appointment in ESIC. The engagement is subject to the rules, instructions and guidelines of ESIC Headquarters/Government of India issued from time to time. Private practice of any kind is not permitted after joining ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Faridabad. Either side may end the engagement with one month's notice, in accordance with the terms and conditions of appointment. Candidates finally selected as Junior Resident/Tutor/Demonstrator must submit a demand draft of Rs. 20,000/- at the time of joining as a security deposit. The draft must be in favour of ESI Fund Account No. 1, payable at Faridabad. The deposit is refunded only if the candidate serves at least six months after joining. If the candidate resigns within six months of joining, the deposit will be forfeited and will not be refunded under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice describes these stages: scrutiny of applications, then Document Verification, then a Written Test. ESIC will notify on its website whether the Written Test is required. Document Verification will preferably be held on the same day as the candidate's written test, so that candidates do not have to visit the institute more than once. After the last date, a designated committee/authority will scrutinise all applications for educational qualifications, age, registration, reservation and other eligibility conditions. Every candidature remains subject to detailed verification of eligibility and original documents. The date, time and venue will be notified separately on the official ESIC website. Only candidates who meet the eligibility conditions and whose documents are found satisfactory will be allowed into the next stage of selection. Whether a Written Test is needed will be decided by the number of eligible applications for each post compared with the vacancies advertised for that post. ESIC will notify the date, time, venue and other details on its website. The syllabus is based on the MBBS curriculum, and the qualifying criteria is 50% marks in the written examination. The list of selected candidates will be notified on the ESIC website through a separate notice and also sent by mail to the candidates concerned.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ESIC Faridabad Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted in both online (email) and offline mode from 3 November 2026 to 13 November 2026. Fill in the Application Form in the prescribed format at Annexure-I and sign it. Attach clear and legible self-attested copies of all supporting documents. For fee-paying candidates, this includes the Demand Draft details or a copy of the Demand Draft. Online mode: email the application to [email protected] . The form and all documents should preferably be in one consolidated PDF file. Name the PDF file with your name followed by your mobile number. For example, Rahul with mobile number 9845322*** would name the file Rahul9845322***. Use this email subject line where possible: "Application for the post of _ [Name of Candidate]". Offline mode: submit the application in Room No.9, Academic Block, ESIC MC&H, Faridabad. Make sure the complete application is received by 13 November 2026. Applications received after 13.11.2026, or applications that are incomplete, unsigned or missing the required documents, are liable to be rejected. The Annexure-I form asks for: Personal details: name in block letters, father's/husband's name, date of birth, age, gender, nationality, PAN and Aadhaar number. Permanent address. Contact details: mobile, alternate mobile and email. Educational qualifications, latest first. Professional experience, latest first. A list of documents enclosed. A recent passport-size self-attested photograph affixed on the form. A signed declaration.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Enclose self-attested copies of these documents with the application: Class 10th/Matriculation Certificate as proof of Date of Birth All relevant Mark Sheets and Degree Certificates MBBS Degree Certificate, wherever applicable M.Sc./Ph.D. Degree Certificate, wherever applicable Valid EWS/OBC-NCL/SC/ST/PwBD Certificate, wherever applicable, in the prescribed format for appointment to Central Government posts Valid and updated NMC/State Medical Council Registration Certificate, wherever applicable Experience Certificate, wherever applicable Recent passport-size photograph Relieving Certificate/NOC from present/previous employer, wherever applicable Aadhaar Card/valid identity document Demand Draft towards the prescribed Application/Interview Fee, wherever applicable Any other document/certificate required for determining eligibility for the post Bring the following to Document Verification: All original certificates/documents submitted with the application One complete set of self-attested photocopies The original Demand Draft, wherever applicable Valid registration certificate, wherever applicable Original experience certificate, wherever applicable Original caste/category certificate, wherever applicable Any other document specified in the Document Verification notice Failure to produce original documents, or failure to satisfy the Document Verification Committee about their authenticity/validity, will result in cancellation of candidature.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ESIC Faridabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 66 provisional vacancies: 34 for Junior Resident and 32 for Tutor/Demonstrator.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for ESIC Faridabad Junior Resident and Tutor/Demonstrator posts?
faq.answer: The last date is 13 November 2026, for both online (email) and offline applications. Applications are received from 3 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Junior Resident post?
faq.answer: The Junior Resident post requires an MBBS Degree.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Tutor/Demonstrator post?
faq.answer: A Tutor needs an MBBS. A Demonstrator needs a valid MSc Degree and PhD in the same subject (Anatomy, Biochemistry, Pharmacology, Physiology or Microbiology), as per NMC Norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for ESIC Faridabad Junior Resident and Tutor/Demonstrator?
faq.answer: Both posts carry pay equivalent to Level 10 of the 7th CPC, with other allowances as applicable.

faq.question: Q6. Are allowances paid on top of the Level 10 pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice says the pay is equivalent to Level 10 of the 7th CPC "with other allowances as applicable".

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹ 500/-, paid by Demand Draft in favour of ESI Fund Account No. 1, Payable at Faridabad. SC/ST, Female, Ex-Servicemen and PH candidates are exempted, and the fee is not refundable.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply?
faq.answer: You can email the signed Annexure-I form and documents to [email protected], or submit them in Room No.9, Academic Block, ESIC MC&H, Faridabad, by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is there a written test, and what are the qualifying marks?
faq.answer: ESIC will decide on a Written Test based on the number of eligible applications for each post and will notify it on its website. The syllabus is based on the MBBS curriculum, and the qualifying criteria is 50% marks.

faq.question: Q10. Is a security deposit required at joining?
faq.answer: Yes. Selected candidates must submit a demand draft of Rs. 20,000/- at joining. It is refunded only after at least six months of service and is forfeited if the candidate resigns within six months.
